name: Aibubu
description: 营销图片与视频生成：电商主图、商品场景图、广告变体、图生视频，先报价后生成。
description_zh: 营销图片与视频生成：电商主图、商品场景图、广告变体、图生视频，先报价后生成。
description_en: Marketing image and video generation: product shots, scenes, ad variants, image-to-video.
examples_zh: 把这张商品图做成白底主图和三张场景图，先报价
用 Aibubu 列出可用的视频模型，并比较 5 秒视频的积分价格
把这张主图做成 5 秒图生视频，生成前告诉我预计积分
给这款保温杯生成 4 张不同风格的广告图变体，先查余额和报价
examples_en: Turn this product photo into a white-background hero shot and three lifestyle scenes, quote first
List the available Aibubu video models and compare the credit price of a 5-second clip
Make a 5-second image-to-video clip from this hero image and tell me the estimated credits first
Generate four ad variants in different styles for this thermos, check my balance and quote first
